description: Municipal Contribution To Roads is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. According to the Provincial Municipal Service Exchange Agreement, municipalities are required to pay the province for the cost of maintaining of the local roads constructed pre-April 1, 1995. The fees paid by municipalities started at $3,500 per kilometer and is adjusted annually by the CPI for Canada. Coverage: Government of Nova Scotia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. Its tags are municipality, local roads, mandatory contributions, municipalité, routes locales. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, OTHER, RDF, RSS. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Nova Scotia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
